description_en: Retrieves available Sensitive Data Type Templates and the Desensitization Rules they support. Use the response from this API to configure your Desensitization Rules
description_zh: 调用DsgQueryDefaultTemplates接口，查询可选择的敏感类型模版列表及该模版支持的脱敏规则。您可参考该接口的返回参数配置脱敏规则
name: DsgQueryDefaultTemplates

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Level-2 Desensitization Scene. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2786322.html API to obtain this ID
parameters.help_zh: 二级脱敏场景ID。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2786322.html接口获取
parameters.name: scene_id
